title: 第十九章 我的枪第一次见血第二十章 我又反悔了
slug: 武道长生从大离第一纨绔开始

read2（）;山洞中，突遇袭击的顾尘风早有防备。
开天造化诀的强大灵觉，和兽语精通。
令他早已察觉，洞中蛰伏着一道强劲气息，提前防备。
“呼……！”
顾尘风抡掌如电，似一条长鞭甩出，正中那道血红身影。
“啪”的一声爆响。
顾尘风只觉手掌剧震，微微发麻。
“嘶！”
一声嘶鸣传来，那红影也被震退。
顾尘风定睛一看，便看到自己身前，两丈之遥。
一条长约丈许，身体灰黑，背脊处生有一条红线，延伸至头顶的大蛇。
正盘身昂头，用一双幽冷蛇眼，死死盯着自己，蛇信吞吐不定。
那造型与“过山峰”极为相似。
顾尘风目光收缩，脑海迅速从此前看过的典籍中，翻找出此兽的信息。
“血冠蛇，性凶残，嗜血肉，无毒，成年可达通脉境。”
其体内精血，可孕育血冠花，并以此诱捕猎物。
这条血冠蛇的血线，已经变成了暗红色，长及尾部。
实力应该堪比，通脉境九星的武者。
山洞一角，还堆着不少白骨，有野兽，也有人类的，足见此兽的凶残。

然而，顾尘风看着大蛇，却有种见猎心喜之感。
“总算上点难度了。”
他这些天遇到的源兽，战斗力都太弱，最多两拳就能解决战斗。
顾尘风也不可能为了磨砺自身，闯进太荒岭深处犯险。
眼前这条血冠蛇，和自己修为相当，而且是无毒，是个不错的练手对象。
显然，血冠蛇也感知到，眼前这个人类，实力非同一般。
然而，它的凶残本性，令它不可能放过，这送上门的大餐。
只稍一犹豫，血冠蛇眼中寒芒一闪。
“嘶！”
蛇身骤然弹射而起，灰黑色的鳞甲，与昏暗的山洞相融。
只有背部那条红线，如一道血色电光，飞袭而来。
血冠蛇的速度很快，但顾尘风反应更快，抬手又是一巴掌。
“啪！”
巴掌抽打在蛇首，发出一声爆响，血冠蛇再度被震退。
血冠蛇吃痛，非但没有退缩，反而被激起凶性。
它尖啸一声，接连发起进攻。
顾尘风目光锁定对方，双掌抡动如风车。
“啪啪啪……！”
转眼间数十个巴掌抡出去。
血冠蛇非但没有近身，伤到顾尘风分毫。

read2(); In the cave, Gu Chenfeng was prepared for the sudden attack.
The powerful spiritual sense of the Kaitian Creation Technique, and proficiency in animal language.
He had already noticed that there was a strong aura dormant in the cave, so he took precautions in advance.
"Huh...!"
Gu Chenfeng swung his palm like lightning, like a long whip, hitting the blood-red figure in the middle.
There was an explosion.
Gu Chenfeng felt his palms shaking violently and numbing slightly.
"Hiss!"
A neighing sound was heard, and the red figure was also shaken back.
Gu Chenfeng took a closer look and saw two feet away in front of him.
A large snake about ten feet long, with a gray and black body and a red line on its back that extended to the top of its head.
He was crossing his body and raising his head, staring at himself with a pair of cold snake eyes, the snake was hesitant.
The shape is very similar to "Crossing the Mountain".
Gu Chenfeng's eyes narrowed, and his mind quickly searched for information about this beast from the classics he had read before.
"The blood-crowned snake is ferocious in nature, thirsty for blood and flesh, and is non-venomous. It can reach the channel-opening state when it reaches adulthood."
The essence and blood in its body can breed blood crown flowers and use them to trap prey.
The blood line of this blood-crowned snake has turned dark red and reaches its tail.
The strength should be comparable to that of a nine-star warrior in Tongmai Realm.
In the corner of the cave, there are many bones piled up, including those of wild beasts and humans, which shows the ferocity of this beast.
However, when Gu Chenfeng looked at the big snake, he felt happy to see it.
"It's finally a bit more difficult."
The source beasts he encountered these days were all too weak in combat power, and the battle could be resolved with at most two punches.
It is impossible for Gu Chenfeng to go into the depths of Taihuang Ridge and take risks in order to hone himself.
The blood-crowned snake in front of me was similar to my own cultivation level, and it was non-venomous, making it a good training target.
Obviously, Blood Crown Snake also sensed that the human being in front of him had extraordinary strength.
However, its ferocious nature makes it impossible for it to let go of this feast that is delivered to your door.
After just a moment's hesitation, a cold light flashed in the blood-crowned snake's eyes.
"Hiss!"
The snake's body suddenly shot up, its gray-black scales blending into the dim cave.
Only the red line on the back, like a streak of bloody lightning, flew towards him.
The blood-crowned snake was very fast, but Gu Chenfeng reacted faster, raised his hand and slapped him again.
"Crack!"
The slap hit the snake's head, making an explosion, and the blood-crowned snake was knocked back again.
The blood-crowned snake was in pain, but instead of flinching, it became ferocious.
It screamed and launched attacks one after another.
Gu Chenfeng locked eyes with the other party and moved his palms like windmills.
"Bah bang bang...!"
In the blink of an eye, dozens of slaps were thrown out.
Not only did the blood-crowned snake not get close, it hurt Gu Chenfeng at all.
